title: A product with no business is accepted but invisible to everyone else
standards: project-brain/DECISIONS.md 2026-10-24 (every product belongs to a business)
steps: As a user with no business, POST /api/products {title, price, stock, status:'active'} → 201.
GET it as another user or guest → 404.
expected: Creation is refused with a clear message when no business can be resolved, as the 2026-10-24 decision implies.
actual: The API creates the product (201); it is then hidden from every viewer except the creator. The legacy checkout E2E spec relies on this path.
impact: A seller can list products that nobody can ever see, with no explanation.
fix: Reject creation with 422 'Create a business first' when resolveProductBusiness returns null (admins included), and show that guidance on /products/create.
